name: indicadores-economicos-mexico

name: student-affordability-calculator
what_it_holds: Streamlit app combining live Numbeo cost-of-living data with European Central Bank FX rates to compute affordability across 326 cities in 107 countries for international students. No stored dataset — live-pull method combining two APIs.
why_useful: Demonstrates a working method for merging crowdsourced cost-of-living data with ECB FX rates into a single affordability score across 326 cities — a reusable pattern (not data) for an ABNB cross-market affordability index that already accounts for currency.
themes: Currency and travel affordability crowdsourced data: Numbeo, Expatistan, hotel price indices (Hotels.com HPI archives), Trivago Hotel Price Index, Kayak price trackers
why_all: Demonstrates a working method for merging crowdsourced cost-of-living data with ECB FX rates into a single affordability score across 326 cities — a reusable pattern (not data) for an ABNB cross-market affordability index that already accounts for currency.

name: hackpr-challenge (Puerto Rico COLI calculator)
what_it_holds: Hackathon challenge repo built around official Puerto Rico Institute of Statistics Cost-of-Living Index (COLI) data: 'COLI 2014Q3-2015Q3.xls' (quarterly index values, ~57 priced products, San Juan Metro vs ~300 C2ER regions) plus a 'Puerto Rico Index Compiler 2014Q3-2015Q3.xls' showing the aggregation formulas. Government-sourced, not crowdsourced, but a genuine point-in-time quarterly cost index with underlying category weights.
why_useful: Marginal: shows how an official regional cost-of-living index (C2ER-style, same family as ACCRA/COLI that Numbeo/Expatistan approximate) is constructed quarter by quarter with full category weights - useful as a methodology reference for building a point-in-time affordability index, even though geography (Puerto Rico only) and vintage (2014-15) are narrow.
geography: Puerto Rico (San Juan Metro) vs ~300 US/Canada C2ER regions
themes: Currency and travel affordability crowdsourced data: Numbeo, Expatistan, hotel price indices (Hotels.com HPI archives), Trivago Hotel Price Index, Kayak price trackers
why_all: Marginal: shows how an official regional cost-of-living index (C2ER-style, same family as ACCRA/COLI that Numbeo/Expatistan approximate) is constructed quarter by quarter with full category weights - useful as a methodology reference for building a point-in-time affordability index, even though geography (Puerto Rico only) and vintage (2014-15) are narrow.

name: city-cost-of-living-index (Kazakhstan)
what_it_holds: Committed CSVs (data/cost_piv.csv housing costs, data/spend_piv.csv monthly household expenditure) built from Kazakhstan's official stat.gov.kz economic-dynamics tables, plus a datapackage.json and processing scripts (cost.py, spend.py, datapack.py). Public-domain (ODC-PDDL) license. Government-sourced, not Numbeo/crowdsourced.
why_useful: A genuine committed cost-of-living dataset with a clear government source and reproducible build scripts, but narrow geography (Kazakhstan cities only) limits direct relevance to ABNB's core markets.
license: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication (ODC-PDDL)
themes: Currency and travel affordability crowdsourced data: Numbeo, Expatistan, hotel price indices (Hotels.com HPI archives), Trivago Hotel Price Index, Kayak price trackers
why_all: A genuine committed cost-of-living dataset with a clear government source and reproducible build scripts, but narrow geography (Kazakhstan cities only) limits direct relevance to ABNB's core markets.

name: india-cost-of-living-index
what_it_holds: Committed JSON dataset (public/data/cities.json) covering 50 Indian cities across 8 expense categories (housing, grocery, transport, healthcare, education, electricity, restaurant, movies), described as aggregated from 'multi-source data' (>50,000 data points), indexed to Delhi=100. Source methodology not fully documented in the visible README.
why_useful: A committed, structured cost-of-living panel for 50 Indian cities could be a useful India-specific affordability proxy for APAC regional splits (gap #7), though the undocumented sourcing and recency make it lower confidence than an official statistics series.
themes: Currency and travel affordability crowdsourced data: Numbeo, Expatistan, hotel price indices (Hotels.com HPI archives), Trivago Hotel Price Index, Kayak price trackers
